# airlock_application_category (Resource)

Manage an Airlock application category or subcategory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_application_category" "example" {
  name               = "tf-example-category"
  parent_category_id = "0000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Category name.
- `parent_category_id` (String) Parent category ID. Airlock creates categories beneath an existing parent category.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Airlock object ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_application_category.example 1700000001
```
